description: Optimize and convert a 3D model to GLTF using the VNTANA Intelligent 3D Optimization Engine.
inputInstructions:
Optimizes a 3D model with VNTANA ModelOps and outputs glTF (.gltf). Requires a licensed ModelOps deployment. Select the source model as the input file.

This pipeline reads no asset or file metadata — optimization settings come from this template.
